levels.title: Comet Count
levels.intro: Welcome to the Number Nebula, Explorer! Look, comets are zooming by! Tap each one and let's count them together.

rounds.prompt: More comets! Tap and count them all!
So many comets! Count every one!

levels.title: Find the Number
levels.intro: Numbers are hiding among the stars! When I say a number, tap it as fast as you can!

rounds.question: Which one is the number three?
rounds.spoken: Can you find the number three?
rounds.hint: Look for the number three!

rounds.question: Which one is the number one?
rounds.spoken: Now find the number one!
rounds.hint: One is a tall straight line!

rounds.question: Which one is the number five?
rounds.spoken: Where is the number five hiding?
rounds.hint: Look for the number five!

rounds.question: Which one is the number two?
rounds.spoken: Can you spot the number two?
rounds.hint: Two looks like a swan swimming!

rounds.question: Which one is the number four?
rounds.spoken: Last one! Find the number four!
rounds.success: Four! You know all your numbers!
rounds.hint: Look for the number four!

levels.title: Number Friends
levels.intro: Every number has a best friend — a group that's just its size! Drag each number to its matching group.

matchPairs.prompt: Drag each number to its matching group!

levels.title: How Many?
levels.intro: Time for a counting hunt! Count what's inside each bubble, and tap the group I ask for!

rounds.question: Tap the group with TWO suns!
rounds.spoken: Count carefully! Tap the group with two suns!
rounds.hint: Count each group! Which has exactly two?

rounds.question: Tap the group with THREE moons!
rounds.spoken: Now find the group with three moons!
rounds.hint: Count them one by one!

rounds.question: Tap the group with FOUR stars!
rounds.spoken: Which group has four stars?
rounds.hint: Keep counting! Four is what we want!

rounds.question: Tap the group with FIVE aliens!
rounds.spoken: Can you find five friendly aliens?
rounds.hint: Count all the aliens in each bubble!

rounds.question: Tap the group with SIX planets!
rounds.spoken: Last one! Find six planets!
rounds.success: Six planets! You're a counting champion!
rounds.hint: Six is a big number! Count carefully!

levels.title: Number Train
levels.intro: All aboard the number train! The numbers got mixed up. Tap them in order, starting from one!

rounds.prompt: Tap the numbers in order! One comes first!
rounds.success: One, two, three! The train is rolling!

rounds.prompt: A longer train! Start at one!
rounds.success: One, two, three, four! Choo choo!

rounds.prompt: The longest train yet! You can do it!
rounds.success: All five in order! What a superstar!

levels.title: More or Less
levels.intro: Some groups are big and some are small! Look at both sides and tell me which has more, and which has fewer.

rounds.question: Which side has MORE rockets?
rounds.spoken: Look at both sides! Which has more rockets?
rounds.success: Yes! Five is more than two!
rounds.hint: Count each side! More means a bigger number!

rounds.question: Which side has MORE butterflies?
rounds.spoken: Which side has more butterflies?
rounds.hint: Which bubble looks fuller?

rounds.question: Which side has FEWER moons?
rounds.spoken: Tricky one! Which side has fewer moons?
rounds.success: Three is fewer than six! Fewer means less!
rounds.hint: Fewer means the smaller group!

rounds.question: Which side has MORE stars?
rounds.spoken: Which side has more stars?
rounds.success: Five stars is more than three!
rounds.hint: Count both sides carefully!

rounds.question: Which side has FEWER aliens?
rounds.spoken: Last one! Which side has fewer aliens?
rounds.success: Two is fewer than four! You've got it!
rounds.hint: Fewer means the smaller group!

levels.title: Sorting Station
levels.intro: The sorting station is open! Count what's in each group, then drag it to its number!

sortBins.prompt: Count each group, then drag it to its number!

levels.title: Star Pickers
levels.intro: Now for BIG numbers! Let's count higher than ever before. Tap everything you see!

rounds.prompt: Tap each star and count to five!
Six aliens are waving! Count them all!
Seven planets! Can you count that high?

levels.title: Rocket Countdown
levels.intro: Rockets count BACKWARDS before they launch! Tap the numbers from biggest to smallest, and blast off!

rounds.spoken: Count down for launch! Three comes first!

rounds.prompt: A bigger countdown! Start at five!
rounds.spoken: Now count down from five!
rounds.success: Five, four, three, two, one... BLAST OFF! Whoooosh!

levels.title: Zibb's Number Quiz
levels.intro: It's the great number quiz! Show me everything you've learned, Explorer. Big numbers ahead!

rounds.question: Which one is the number seven?
rounds.spoken: Find the number seven!
rounds.hint: Look for the number seven!

rounds.question: Tap the group with EIGHT stars!
rounds.spoken: Count carefully! Which group has eight stars?
rounds.hint: Eight is a lot! Count each star!

rounds.question: Which one is the number nine?
rounds.spoken: Where is the number nine?
rounds.hint: Careful — six and nine love to trick explorers!

rounds.question: Which side has MORE planets?
rounds.spoken: Which side has more planets?
rounds.hint: Count both sides!

rounds.question: Which one is the number TEN?
rounds.spoken: The biggest one of all! Find the number ten!
rounds.success: TEN! You found ten! You know ALL the numbers, Explorer!
rounds.hint: Ten has two parts — a one and a zero!
